name: LAGET DISCOVERY SLR
why_interesting: A semi-3D-printed titanium gravel frameset with an official 1.55 kg size-S weight, 45 mm clearance, UDH and a ¥14,900 domestic price.
missing: Exact included mainland frameset package beyond the stated carbon fork
China checkout route and domestic warranty entity
Clarify whether the official 1.55 kg size-S value includes any frameset hardware
A reliably embeddable exact product image
Exact titanium alloy grade and an independent measured stiffness or deflection result

facts.frame: Semi-3D-printed titanium gravel frame with carbon fork
facts.frame_material: Titanium frame with carbon fork; exact titanium alloy grade is not published
facts.frame_construction: Semi-3D-printed construction: a 3D-printed titanium front triangle joined to a hand-welded rear triangle
facts.stiffness_evidence: No exact-model measured stiffness or attributable independent ride assessment was found; the construction method is recorded without inferring a stiffness ranking
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-S product-page value; hardware inclusion is not stated
facts.drivetrain_compatibility: Mechanical or electronic shifting; official page states 42T maximum for 1×

source_note: The official exact-model page supplies the size-S 1.55 kg value, 700×45C maximum, T47×85.5 mm bottom bracket, UDH, axle standards and ¥14,900 retail price. Hardware inclusion for the weight remains unstated.
